ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity dominant; approximately 90% high-intensity (white) pixels to 10% low-intensity (black/dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region across both lobes; low-intensity dark border along the trailing edge and tips; sparse low-intensity focal spots (specks) distributed on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees; apex is clearly defined at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude is greater on the outer thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the outer edges of both lobes, sweeping from the notch to the distal tips with an upward orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast cluster of light-colored, irregular circular nodes (barnacle colonization) localized on the far right distal tip; secondary clusters of small dark spots on the medial right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) including three parallel diagonal lines and one near-horizontal mark on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle encrustation on the right distal tip altering the geometric profile; localized yellowish-tan pigmentation/stain near the base of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark pigmentation band on the trailing edge of the left lobe versus a thinner, more broken dark band on the right lobe.
